_doc: p95 ceilings in ms, checked by make bench (bench) and the load test (loadtest). In CI a bench row over warns, and goes red only when over in two main runs in a row (bench.yml, bench repeat). This file only tightens: lowering a number needs nothing. Raising one, or removing a row, needs a one-line reason in the same PR: why on the row, or an entry in retired ('bench/<row>': reason). Any agent may do that, no sign-off (CI: bench tighten). issue-* and replica-* cannot pass the 16 ms bar (ceilings.go). Numbers come from Sengi runs, never a Mac: the highest p95 of several runs x 1.6 + 1 ms in bench, which retries a row, and x 2 + 2 ms in loadtest, which cannot; never above the SPEC's budget (DESIGN-NOTES, The speed gate).

zero-start.why: no regression (Sengi interleaved A/B 43573208036: same-VM p50s within 2.2 ms); the reds were slower Sengi VMs (p50 123-182 ms across runs); worst Sengi p95 200.8 x 1.25; was 155 (2026-11-01); tightens again once zero-start is optimised
